theme_strategy.primary_theme: Institutional Green & Clean Functional Slate (UNPA-UACO identity)
theme_strategy.context: University Dining Hall Operations, Meal Reservations, Payments & Kitchen Demand SaaS (Mobile-First)

three_mode_support.light: Clean ivory/soft-slate background, crisp dark green headers, institutional forest green CTA/badges, high-contrast dark grey body
three_mode_support.dark: Deep obsidian/emerald slate (#0b1411), dark muted card surfaces (#12201b), bright institutional emerald accents (#22c55e / #10b981)
three_mode_support.high_contrast: Pure stark black/yellow/white token set with 3px solid borders, #000000 background, #FFFF00 / #00FF66 high-visibility accents, 100% text opacity

accessibility_panel_rules.global_presence: Universally available on all views including login via top navbar button with universal accessibility icon (UniversalAccess / Eye)
accessibility_panel_rules.text_scaling: Rem-based global font scaling (80%, 90%, 100%, 110%, 125%, 150%) via root dataset or CSS variable on <html>
accessibility_panel_rules.persistence: Persisted in localStorage ('unpa_uaco_a11y_prefs') with 'Restablecer valores predeterminados' button and X close button

theme_strategy.no_food_photos_rule: CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: Strictly NO food photography or food photo placeholders. Menus are pure typographic cards with dish title, nutritional/dietary badges (Celiaquía, Vegetariano, Calórico), date, and calculated price per profile.

entry_surfaces./: UNPA-UACO Dining Hall auth hub & quick role switch demo with Institutional Green crest banner and accessibility drawer trigger
entry_surfaces./login: Branded single-screen UNPA-UACO credential access with quick demo preset switcher (Estudiante, Docente, Admin, Cocina)

visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for inputs and buttons, rounded-full for status badges
visual_enhancers.qr_code_rendering: Clean SVG QR visualizer for validated/paid meal tickets with animated scan simulation border
visual_enhancers.tactile_states: Subtle green ring highlights on active tabs, active status badges (Verde éxito: #15803d, Amarillo pendiente: #b45309, Rojo cancelado: #b91c1c)

business_logic_rules.cutoff_time: 14:00 hs (Zona horaria Argentina UTC-3) para reserva del día siguiente. Pasadas las 14:00 el botón se deshabilita con aviso claro.
business_logic_rules.booking_limit: Máximo 1 vianda por comensal por día hábil.

grids_and_layouts.mobile_first: Single column flex-col with sticky bottom summary or top actions on viewports < 768px
grids_and_layouts.desktop_dashboard: Grid 12-column with 4-col KPI cards, 8-col dynamic table/scanner, 4-col live demand sidebar
grids_and_layouts.menu_catalog: Grid 1-col on mobile, 2-col on tablet, 3-col on desktop for daily menu cards (textual layout)

motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-out, transition-transform duration-150 ease-out
motion.feedback: Sonner toast notifications on reserve, transfer upload, verification approval, and QR delivery scan
motion.accessibility_respect: Respects prefers-reduced-motion with instant snap transitions when motion reduced

accessibility.panel_implementation: Accessible drawer / modal sheet with title 'Accesibilidad', scale slider + preset buttons (80%, 100%, 120%, 140%), theme toggles (Claro, Oscuro, Alto Contraste), and reset button
accessibility.aria_labels: All action buttons and icon buttons must include aria-label and role attributes
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full keyboard tab support across modal dialogs, calendar selectors, and menu tabs
accessibility.contrast_guarantee: Minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for all body text across light, dark, and high-contrast modes

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's color requirement: Verde oscuro (#0D3825 / #064E3B) for headers/navbar, Verde institucional (#15803D / #16A34A) for positive actions and buttons, Verde claro (#E8F5EE) for secondary backgrounds/highlights, White/Light slate for surfaces, Dark charcoal (#13231B / #1E293B) for typography. Avoid blue as dominant color.
NO food photos or placeholder images anywhere. Design clean typographic menu cards with dish title, ingredients/description, dietary tags, price and day badge.

Implement the global Accessibility Panel (Panel de Accesibilidad) accessible via the navbar on every single route (including Login). It must control font scaling (rem multiplier) and theme switching (Claro, Oscuro, Alto Contraste) with localStorage persistence and a default reset button.

Include pre-seeded realistic Argentine university data: Estudiantes (e.g. Mateo Rossi, Lucía Fernández), Docentes (e.g. Prof. Carlos Méndez), Menús semanales (Guiso de lentejas patagónico, Milanesa con puré mixto, Cazuela de pollo y verduras, Pastel de papa, Tartas individuales de verdura), Transacciones con comprobantes simulados y Scanner de QR/DNI interactivo con feedback visual verde/rojo/amarillo.
Provide quick demo user switcher on Login page so any evaluator can instantly test Comensal Estudiante, Comensal Docente, Administrador Mostrador/Caja, or Personal de Cocina with a single click.
